newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean shares end week firmer in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean shares end week firmer in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrials closed firmer on Friday on continued high investor appetite for stocks at the expense of the local money market where interest rates remained stagnant and unattractive.
The key index lept 187.52 points to close at 11,972.12, a new record high, surging 502.07 points during the week.
Counters to trade firmer included cement firm Porthold which climbed 450 cents to 3,000 while food proccessors Natfoods added 100 cents to 950.

Soft drink firm Schweppes, riding on good half-year results for the period ended June 30, put on 30 cents to 450, newspaper group Zimpapers gained 25 cents to 145 amd hotel giant Zimsun was up 20 cents to 520.

In minings, coal producer Wankie added 50 cents to 800 while gold company Falgold eased four cents to 71. The seven-share index climbed 16.7 points on Friday to 864.48, gaining 71.61 points on the week.
